secs.t: Child labour: laws, committee and enforcement

x: First Child Labour Law in India:
Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (Child Labour Act, 1986).
Landmark committee that recognized child labour is directly tied to poverty; led to the 1986 Child Labour Act.
a dual approach of banning hazardous child labor while regulating other forms.

Complete ban (prohibition) on employing children below 14 in all occupations; regulates (restricts) adolescents (14–18) working in hazardous conditions / processes.

First Constitutional Amendment making Education a Fundamental Right:
Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act, 2009:
Enforces Article 21A; free and compulsory education (ages 6–14); mandates 25% reservation (quota) for disadvantaged groups in private unaided schools.
